name: Reno Spring 2019

venue.name: University of Nevada, Reno

venue.details: Wells Fargo Auditorium, in the Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center.

information:
Wells Fargo Auditorium is located on the first floor of the Knowledge Center, and is accessible from the southwest entrance.

All competitors under the age of 18 must bring a signed waiver, which will be made available to competitors prior to the competition.
